newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Abiove soybean crush 2.16 mln tns in May.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Abiove soybean crush 2.16 mln tns in May.

text.p: Brazilian firms contributing to the Brazilian Vegetable Oils Industries Association (Abiove) crushed 2.16 million tonnes of soybeans in May, up from 2.01 million in April, Abiove said.

Total crushings in the 1997/98 marketing year (February/January) were 6.64 million tonnes. Abiove estimates the data it received in May represents between 88 and 90 percent of total Brazilian crushings. Between February and April the data received represented 90 to 92 percent of total crushings, it added.
As well as using domestic soybeans, Brazil imported a total of 298,000 tonnes between February and May, Abiove said.
The May figure left industry stocks at 6.70 million tonnes, down from 6.82 million tonnes at the end of April.
Crushings last year in May, when contributing companies represented 100 percent of the sector, reached 2.38 million tonnes, according to Abiove statistics.
Soybean stocks at the end of the month in 1996 were 6.94 million tonnes.
